title: jev error
description: The single JSON object `jev` prints on stderr when a command fails and the output format is machine-readable (`-o json`, `-o yaml`, `-o jsonl`, or stdout not a terminal), and the error a `jev mcp serve` tool call returns. `code` is a stable name; `exit_code` is the process exit code. Every field is always present.

code.description:
A stable, machine-readable name for the failure, such as `usage`, `authentication`,
`api_rejected`, `rate_limited`, `timeout` or `not_implemented`.

exit_code.description:
The process exit code: 1 internal, 2 usage or validation, 3 auth, 4 API rejected, 5 rate
limited or overloaded, 6 network or timeout, 7 batch partial failure, 130 interrupted.
Never 10 or 11: those mean an evaluation succeeded and a gate decided.

error_type.description: The API's own `error_type` when it sent one, passed through unchanged.

message.description: What went wrong, in one sentence.

hint.description: The next action to take, such as the flag or command that fixes it.

request_id.description: The `x-typesafe-request-id` of the failed call, to quote when asking TypeSafe about it.

http_status.description: The HTTP status the API answered with, when the failure came from the API.

retryable.description: Whether trying the same thing again later may succeed.

details.description: Structured detail, such as the findings of a failed validation, or `null`.

error.description: What went wrong, and what to do next.
